target.sentence: After confirming that human CD40L can up-regulate expression of Fas, B7-1, and B7-2 molecules on murine BCL cells in vitro, we transfected the human CD40L gene into S typhimurium mutant (ST40L), which was administrated orally to determine whether it was able to prevent the growth of BCL in mice.
